Alex — quick note from the pen-test side.

We typically run pen-test scoping as a 30-minute focused call that covers:
- Allowed test vectors (external vs internal, credentials)
- Target model endpoints and any rate limits
- Data handling expectations and responsible disclosure

If FinTrust intends to have its vendor run active exploitation, we need vendor NDA/DPA in place and to understand whether you need us to demonstrate any exploit chains (we normally avoid live exploit demos in intake calls; we can provide detailed playbooks).

I'll add a HubSpot meeting record and a short DocuSign link for our standard DPA if that helps accelerate legal review: https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/12345/fintrust-intake

—Ben
